learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the magic of doing one thing at a time to do it perfectly!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When you study just study. When you play just play. Doing one thing at a time makes you very good at it.
If we try to do too many things together we might make mistakes. A smart child finishes one job before starting another.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Sorting Game
fun_activity.instructions: Mix pulses and beans in a bowl. Now set a timer and see how fast you can separate them by focusing on just one task!

quick_recap: ⭐ Work while you work and play while you play.
⭐ Focus helps us finish our work faster and better.
⭐ Doing one thing at a time is the secret to success.
